name: web-orange-and-purple-silhouette-hero-with-glass-analysis-cards-and-grid-lines
title: Orange-to-plum blurred profile silhouette hero with white headline, yellow CTAs, glass report cards and crossing guide lines
whatItIs: A framed hero filled with a warm orange to deep plum gradient photo of a profile silhouette with flowing hair, a white 'Detection System Advanced AI Content' headline, yellow and white buttons, translucent report cards (AI Probability Score bars, Origin Report thumbnails, flagged patterns) tied together with thin white guide lines and dots, and a lower right glass panel with badges.
whatItMeans: Warm and analytic; the silhouette and glow keep an AI tool human.
techniques: Use a gradient portrait as the backdrop.
Overlay glass cards joined by thin guide lines.
Use yellow for the primary button.

vocabulary.definition: Thin lines and dots linking overlay cards.
A bar made of small blocks.
A dark figure shape behind UI.
